title: Global Gan–Gross–Prasad Conjecture (Fixed-Representation Form)
exact_target: For each allowed automorphic representation, is its global period nonzero exactly when every local period is allowed and the central $L$-value is nonzero?

sources.citation: Gan, Gross and Prasad, Symplectic local root numbers, central critical L-values, and restriction problems in the representation theory of classical groups, §§23–24, Conjecture 24.1.
